dashboard.title: Welcome back, {name}
dashboard.description: Keep track of your supported teams, open founder invitations, and the next useful steps.
dashboard.heroText: You support founder connections with an outside perspective. Access only starts once both founders have actively approved the advisor relationship.
dashboard.teamsDescription: See each connection's relationship access, current reports, and separate Founder Setup sharing status.
dashboard.emptyText: Once both founders have started and are linked through your invite, the team will appear here with its approval status.
dashboard.emptyHint: Until then, your new invitations appear above as open invites.
dashboard.readyTeamsDescription: Teams with active advisor access and usable working drafts.
dashboard.waitingTeamsDescription: Teams where one founder approval is still missing.
dashboard.pausedTeamsDescription: Teams where your advisor access is not active.
dashboard.readySectionDescription: Both founders have approved. The advisor report is your entry point.
dashboard.waitingSectionDescription: These teams are visible, but not fully approved yet. Keep an eye on the approval status.
dashboard.pausedSectionDescription: Approval is currently not fully active here. The status remains visible, but working access is paused.

inviteTeam.title: Invite two founders
inviteTeam.description: Start a pairwise founder connection. Both founders receive a separate link and must each approve before your advisor access becomes active.
inviteTeam.teamNameHint: Optional. If you add a team or project name, it will appear later in the dashboard and in the founder invitation.
inviteTeam.v1Hint: Founder Setup remains separate; Commitment Lab, deep dives, and open points are not shared.
inviteTeam.sentText: Both founders were invited separately. Your access starts only after both accept.
inviteTeam.createdText: The founder connection is prepared. Check below which email was delivered and resend a failed invitation individually.
inviteTeam.emailDeliveryFailed: At least one email could not be sent right now. The invitation links remain available.
inviteTeam.copyFailed: Copying is not available right now.

errors.invalidFounderAEmail: Please enter a valid email address for Founder A.
errors.invalidFounderBEmail: Please enter a valid email address for Founder B.
errors.emailsMustDiffer: Please use two different founder email addresses.
errors.duplicateInvite: This team has already been invited and appears under “Support”.
errors.createFailed: The team could not be created right now. Please try again.

statuses.waitingSecondApproval: Waiting for the second founder approval
statuses.movesToTeams: Will move to your supported teams shortly

accessDescription.revoked: Access to this team has ended. The report, snapshot and workbook are no longer available – the team stays in this list so you know where you stand.
accessDescription.ready: Both founders have approved. The report and snapshot are available as soon as they are ready.
accessDescription.paused: At least one founder approval is not active right now. Until that changes, the content is closed. Once both have approved again, you can pick up where you left off.
accessDescription.waiting: One founder approval is still missing. Once both founders approve, the team is open for advisor support.

pending.title: Newly invited
pending.description: You have already started these team invites. Once both founders have started, they will automatically move into your supported teams.

followUpsDue.title: {count, plural, one {One follow-up is due} other {# follow-ups are due}}

setupPauseReasons.team_too_small: The team currently consists of one person. Access needs at least two – once two founders are on board again and both agree, it continues.
setupPauseReasons.consent_missing: One approval is missing right now. That happens when somebody joins the team or an approval was withdrawn.
setupPauseReasons.unspecified: Access is not active at the moment.

report.missingText: There is no advisor report to display for this team yet. Once the founder report has been fully generated, you can work with the advisor report here.
report.impulsesText: Capture brief observations or facilitation notes here. Each section has exactly one editable advisor prompt. Clearing a field removes the entry.

preview.dimensionsText: This view describes differences and similarities as a starting point for discussion. It does not evaluate the quality of the team.
preview.classificationContext: This view is meant to start a conversation and does not evaluate the quality of the team.

snapshot.notAvailableText: There is no snapshot available for this team context yet.
snapshot.intro: A compact coaching snapshot with focus areas, advisor prompts, founder response, and the next useful steps.

focus.empty: No observation has been highlighted yet.

advisorClosing.emptyObservations: No observations have been captured yet.
advisorClosing.emptyQuestions: No follow-up questions have been captured yet.
advisorClosing.emptyNextSteps: No next steps have been captured yet.

founderResponse.emptyComment: No shared comment has been captured yet.

invite.notFoundText: This advisor link is no longer valid or could not be matched to a team.
invite.intro: As an advisor, you can see the alignment report, advisor snapshot, and—where available—historical workbook content that was already shared. Raw assessment answers stay protected.
invite.roleText: Your role is a structured outside perspective: capture observations, add follow-up questions, and suggest useful next steps.
invite.alreadyLinkedText: The advisor link is already connected to another profile. If this was not intended, you need a new advisor invitation.
invite.linkProfileText: Sign in so we can link your advisor profile to this team. You'll then go straight to the advisor area.
invite.activateText: Your profile is signed in. With one click, you link yourself as advisor to this founder connection and get the relationship access the founders approved.
invite.activeText: Your profile is already linked to this founder connection. The advisor dashboard shows the areas currently shared with you.
invite.whatYouSee: What you can see as advisor

visibleItems.snapshot: Founder snapshot and prioritized tension or focus areas
visibleItems.workbook: historical workbook content where it already exists and has been shared

invite.notVisible: Raw assessment answers, new alignment deep dives, open points, and the Commitment Lab are not part of this access. Founder Setup requires a separate team grant that covers confirmed content only.

errors.alreadyClaimed: This advisor link is already connected to another profile.
errors.emailMismatch: Please sign in with the email address this advisor invitation was sent to.
errors.invalidToken: The advisor link could not be confirmed.
errors.updateFailed: The link could not be saved right now.

session.title: Session sheet
session.text: Everything you need for a conversation with this team on one page – and the place for your own notes.
session.back: ← Back to the teams you support

saved.setup_request: Your request is now in the team's Founder Setup.

errors.save: That couldn't be saved just now. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: We can't save notes for this team.
errors.follow_up_past: A date in the past won't remind you of anything. Please pick a future date.
errors.setup_request: The request couldn't be sent just now. Please try again – if it fails again, your access to this team may no longer be active.
errors.setup_request_no_team: This team doesn't have a Founder Setup that could be shared yet. The founders set it up themselves.

followUp.title: Your follow-up
followUp.help: When do you want to come back to this team? This is your appointment with yourself – the founders don't see it and aren't notified.
followUp.notePlaceholder: For example: revisit vesting once the company is incorporated
followUp.clearHint: Leaving the date empty removes the follow-up.

note.title: Your notes
note.privacy: These notes are yours. The founders don't see them, and nobody else at Made2Found can read them. They stay with you even if access to this team ends – and they disappear if the team deletes their account.
note.label: Note
note.placeholder: What struck you, what do you want to raise next time, what can't you say yet?

settled.title: What the team has recorded
settled.help: Only the positions the founders confirmed together – that's what they shared with you. Anything still open doesn't appear here.
settled.empty: The team hasn't confirmed a shared position yet.
settled.requestAccessHint: Both founders get the request in their Founder Setup and each decide there themselves. This gives you no access until both have agreed.
settled.noFounderTeam: There is no Founder Setup for this team yet. The founders create it themselves once they open their shared area – after that you can ask for access here.

impulses.title: What you wrote to the founders
impulses.help: Your prompts are visible to the founders – unlike your notes above.
impulses.empty: You haven't added any prompts yet.

document.title: Advisor support – current summary to take with you
document.intro: This sheet summarizes what was recorded while supporting this team: the founders' jointly confirmed positions and the advisor prompts written about them. Both sides know everything on it.
document.settledTitle: What the team has jointly confirmed
document.settledEmpty: As of this summary, the team had not confirmed a shared position yet – or access to it isn't active right now.
document.impulsesEmpty: No advisor prompts have been recorded for this team yet.
document.notesExcluded: Not included: the advisor's private working notes. They are deliberately left out of this sheet – a document that printed them on request would be a promise with an exception, and that is no promise.
document.disclaimer: This sheet records a point in time and is no substitute for legal or tax advice.

personInvites.title: Invite a person
personInvites.text: You invite people by email and ask for access to parts of their profile. Several people, for example the members of a team, go out in one go. There is no people search – it would reveal whether an address has an account.
personInvites.scopesHint: Select each one individually. A blanket request gets a blanket answer — usually none.
personInvites.notePlaceholder: For example: we're supporting you in the program and would like to prepare.
personInvites.notAnAccess: An invitation doesn't grant access. Whoever accepts sees your request in their account, decides area by area — and can withdraw at any time.
personInvites.holderHint: On behalf of the organization, the access stays there when you leave — in your own name, it ends with you.
personInvites.emailsHint: Type an address and confirm with Enter. You can add several people at once, each one gets their own invitation. You can also paste a list.
personInvites.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.
personInvites.noticeInvited: {count, plural, =1 {The invitation is on its way.} other {# invitations are on their way.}}
personInvites.noticeFailed: {failed, plural, =1 {One address did not work.} other {# addresses did not work.}}
personInvites.errorEmail: Please enter at least one valid email address.
personInvites.errorScopes: Please choose at least one area you are asking about.
personInvites.errorCreate: That did not work just now. Please try again.

org.title: Your organization
org.text: A program or consultancy with several advisors. The organization holds the access, so it doesn't disappear when one person leaves.
org.openInvitesText: These people received an invitation. They appear under the members once they have signed in with the invited address and confirmed the invitation.
org.membershipMeaning: Members here see everything shared with the organization. When a membership ends, that access ends at once — but the consent of the person you support stays in place, so your successor doesn't have to ask again. The people you support can see at any time who is a member here.
org.peopleEmpty: Nobody yet. Invite someone, and they'll appear here once they've agreed.
org.personScopes: {count, plural, =0 {nothing shared yet} =1 {1 area shared} other {# areas shared}}
org.personPending: {count, plural, =1 {1 request open} other {# requests open}}
org.claimFailedText: It may have expired, been claimed already, or been addressed to a different email than the one you are signed in with.
org.profileText: Everyone you ask for access sees this — right where they decide. Without it, all they see is a name.
org.profileDescriptionPlaceholder: Two or three sentences: who do you support, for how long, and what happens during that time?

invitePage.title: Join an organization
invitePage.alreadyMember: You are already a member here. If you lead the organization, that stays the same.
invitePage.error: That did not work. Please try again.
invitePage.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
invitePage.unverified: Please confirm your email address first. Then you can join the organization.

org.leaveLastOwner: You are the only person leading this organization. First add another member to the lead under “Members”, or close the organization before you leave.
org.suspended: This organization is suspended. Access through it is currently not active.

errors.org_last_owner: You are the only owner of this organization. Hand over ownership first before you leave.
errors.org_forbidden: Only an owner of the organization can do this.
errors.org_suspended: The organization is suspended. This action is not possible right now.
errors.org_name: The name must be between 2 and 120 characters.
errors.email: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.org_failed: That did not work just now. Please try again.

features.title: Features
features.text: Choose which areas your organization uses. What you switch off disappears for you and for the teams, but is not deleted.
features.setupText: Choose the areas you want to use. You can change this at any time under Set up → Features, and nothing is lost.
features.alwaysOn: Always included: enrolling teams, the program with team cards, milestones, updates, check-ins, members and profile.
features.planText: Dates and tasks for your teams. You enter attendance by hand.
features.materialsText: Links to your storage: folders, slides, recordings. The teams see them.
features.learningText: Modules with lessons as links, visible to all teams, selected teams or selected people you support.
features.expertsText: An internal list with contact details and topics. Teams never see it.
features.orgdataText: Company name, address, contact person and more, kept by you. The team sees it read-only.
features.successText: Results, stars and rewards per team and counts per batch. When switched on, the catalog and rewards appear below.
features.offNote: A switched-off area disappears from the menu, also for the teams. Your entries stay if you switch it on again.
features.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this.
features.fundingText: For funded programs: enter the requirements from the award letter, tick them off and pull the funder report.

personView.intro: Only what this person has shared with you. They can withdraw any share at any time — the section then disappears from here.
personView.scopeNote: The stories from the conversations are never included here — they are never shared, whatever the scope.
personView.workProfileNotShared: The current founder workstyle profile hasn't been shared with you.
personView.legacyText: From the earlier questionnaire, as it was calculated for this person at the time — not necessarily where they stand today. It measures something different from the workstyle profile and is not combined with it. The texts are addressed to the person themselves.

group.title: What does this group look like together?
group.intro: Pick two or more people from your program. You'll see exactly the picture a team sees of itself — no more, no less.
group.chooseHint: You can select anyone who has shared their name and skills with you. Up to twelve.
group.tooFewReleased: Fewer than two of the people you picked have shared both their name and their skills. A line-up needs at least two.

omitted.no_base: {name} isn't included: their name hasn't been shared, and results without a name couldn't be attributed to anyone.
omitted.no_capability: {name} isn't included: their skills haven't been shared.

group.notARanking: This page does not rate a line-up or compute a best combination. It counts areas and shows who has talked about what — this model can't support a single number per group, and such a number would decide who gets into a program.
group.requestText: The overview above shows what each person has shared with you individually. A joint evaluation goes further — it is a statement about how these people relate to each other. That needs everyone's agreement.
group.requestDisclosure: The request itself discloses the group: everyone asked learns who else is involved. There is no other way for anyone to agree to a comparison.
group.requestNotePlaceholder: One sentence on why you are suggesting this.
group.requestDone: Requested. Once everyone has agreed, the joint evaluation appears here.
group.requestFailed: That did not work. You can only ask people who already let you support them individually.
group.reviewWaiting: {count, plural, =1 {waiting for 1 answer} other {waiting for # answers}}

review.intro: Everyone involved has agreed. What you see here is their own entries side by side — not a rating and not a recommendation.
review.rolesOmitted: {count, plural, =1 {One person involved doesn't} other {# people involved don't}} appear here: their skills haven't been shared individually. Joint consent allows a side-by-side view, not access to more data.
review.noRoles: Roles at a glance needs individually shared skills from at least two of the people involved. These aren't available yet.
review.alignmentIntro: Each axis is one dimension from the questionnaire, each dot one person. Far apart is not worse than close together — it is a place worth talking about.
review.alignmentBasis: Self-report, not a test. The dots show how these people described themselves — not how they are, and not how well they fit together.
review.alignmentMissing: Not in the comparison: {names}. They agreed to the joint evaluation, but their questionnaire hasn't been shared.
review.notAVerdict: This page passes no verdict and computes no fit. It places side by side what each person entered and shared themselves. Anyone involved can withdraw at any time — then this page is gone.

teamContext.title: Team report
teamContext.withTeam: This review is linked to a current team report.
teamContext.withoutTeam: The joint review is active. No team report is currently linked to it: a team report is only linked if, at the time of consent, the group matches exactly one current team. A current team report needs a new team-specific share.
teamContext.teamChanged: The joint review stays active. The team's composition has changed since consent was given, so the team report is no longer linked. A new share is needed for the current team report.
teamContext.teamInactive: The joint review stays active. The linked team is no longer active, so there is no team report for it any more.
teamContext.teamUnavailable: The linked team report is currently not available.

notebook.title: Your working file
notebook.private: Only for you. Neither the person you support nor other advisors in your organization can read this — not even the owner.
notebook.notePlaceholder: What stood out last time, what you want to raise next time, what you cannot say yet.
notebook.followUpPlaceholder: What you want to be reminded of.
notebook.survives: Your notes stay when a share ends — the support did happen, after all. They disappear when that person deletes their account.

errors.forbidden: You don't have a mandate for that — not now, and not before.

ended.title: This access is no longer active.
ended.body: Sharing for this profile has ended. What you saw before can no longer be opened here.

pending.title: The request is still open.
pending.body: As soon as the person agrees, you'll see here what they have shared with you.

ended.title: This joint review is no longer active.
ended.body: It has ended. A new review needs new consent from everyone involved.

requested.title: The review is still waiting for answers.
requested.body: As soon as everyone involved has agreed, it will appear here.

orgMembershipEnded.title: Your membership in the organization has ended.
orgMembershipEnded.body: This access came through the organization. It ends with the membership.

orgSuspended.title: The organization is suspended.
orgSuspended.body: Access through this organization is currently not active.

start.summary: You are supporting {people, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} and {teams, plural, one {# team} other {# teams}}.
start.summaryNone: You are not supporting anyone yet.

follow.title: Support
follow.text: Everyone you support: teams, people and group reviews. Each kind has its own consent – here they only stand side by side.
follow.empty: As soon as someone accepts your invitation and releases something to you, it appears here.

invite.title: Invite
invite.text: Three ways, depending on what you want to do. An invitation is not access – access only exists once the invited people agree.
invite.programOwnerOnly: Only the owner of an organization can invite teams to the program.

person.title: Support people
person.text: You invite a person by email and ask for access to parts of their profile. If you want to support a whole team, invite the members one after another, each person for themselves.
person.sees: Each person sees who is asking and what is meant, and decides for themselves.

team.title: A team of two founders
team.text: You invite two founders who decide together what you may see of their team.
team.sees: Both have to agree, otherwise access stays closed.

round.title: Survey a team
round.text: You ask the two to four founders of a team, each one separately and independently, for their view of working together. Two purposes: prepare an admission conversation or reflect on the collaboration.
round.sees: The answers only appear side by side once everyone has submitted. There is no rating and no ranking, just a basis for a conversation.

program.title: Team into the program
program.text: For organizations: you bring a team that already uses Made2Found into your program, by link, email or code. The team enters the code under Align > Program.
program.sees: Everyone on the team agrees. You see the program profile, milestones and updates, nothing else.

org.title: Organization
org.text: A program or consultancy with several advisors. The organization holds the access – so that it doesn't disappear when one person leaves.

orgPage.groupLabels: Care | Team space | Content for the teams | Set up
orgPage.groupHints: Daily work with the teams in the program: overview, teams, dates, report and funding requirements. | How you organize yourselves as a team: what is due this week, tasks, pages and who does what. Only for you, never for the startups. | What your teams read, learn and whom they can ask. | Set up once, rarely touched again: enrolling, program page, features, members, approvals and profile.
orgPage.tabs: Overview | Teams in the program | Program plan | Report | Funding requirements | This week | Tasks | Pages | Who does what | Materials | Learning area | Experts | Enroll teams | Program page | Features & achievements | Members & roles | Approvals | Profile
orgPage.overviewNote: Teams count as in the program once everyone on the team has agreed. The people you support yourself are under “Support”.
orgPage.successText: Which results teams can report, how many stars they bring and which rewards there are. You can switch this off above with the other areas.
orgPage.ownerOnlyNote: This part is set up by the people leading the organization ({names}). You can read along.

teamProgram.sectionText: A team only joins when everyone on it explicitly agrees. Being a member of your organization gives you no access to a team.
teamProgram.inviteShownOnce: This link is only shown now. Copy it and pass it on to the team.
teamProgram.programsEmpty: No team in the program yet.
teamProgram.programsEmptyContact: No team has been assigned to you as a contact yet.
teamProgram.pageText: Here you see which programs your team is in and who can read along.
teamProgram.pageEmpty: Your team is not in any program.
teamProgram.pageNew: You have joined. Everyone else on the team needs to agree here as well; only then is the program active. Let them know.
teamProgram.approvedOf: {approved} of {total} on the team have agreed
teamProgram.endHint: Anyone on the team can end this at any time.
teamProgram.meaning: Agreeing means: the organization (owners and contact people) sees what your team enters into the program, and the agreements confirmed together in the Founder Setup, read-only. Work styles and team review stay separate approvals and are not opened by this. The organization also records whether your team took part in program events; you see your own entry. It sees your replies to events, with names. If the organization uses achievements, both sides record stars, rewards and a progress conversation; you see everything about your team.
teamProgram.inviteText: Choose the team that should take part. It only becomes active once everyone on the team has agreed.
teamProgram.inviteNoTeam: You are not on a team that could take part. Create a team first or join one.
teamProgram.inviteInvalid: This invitation has expired, was already used or was withdrawn.
teamProgram.inviteFailed: That did not work. Please try again.
teamProgram.milestonesText: Set together: the team and the contacts can add milestones and enter progress. Progress is measured against the team's own goal.
teamProgram.milestonesNeedActive: Milestones become available once everyone on the team has agreed.
teamProgram.deadlinesText: Deadline reached, goal not yet entered. A list for asking, not a judgment.
teamProgram.teamPageInactive: This program is not active right now: someone on the team has not agreed yet.
teamProgram.updatesText: A short update to the program every two weeks. The contacts set the questions.
teamProgram.defaultQuestions: What are your current difficulties? | How can we help you?
teamProgram.questionsHint: One question per line, five at most. Without your own questions the default ones apply.
teamProgram.updatesTeamNote: The contacts and the owners of the organization see the answers.
teamProgram.profileText: The team provides these details for the program. They are free text and do not come from your personal profiles.
teamProgram.profileTeamNote: The contacts and the owners of the organization can see them.
teamProgram.profileCompany: Name of the company or project
teamProgram.profileEmpty: The team has not created a program profile yet.
teamProgram.metaNote: The organization sets batch, category and alumni status. The team does not see them as a rating, they only help with the overview.
teamProgram.dashText: Counters and filters across the teams you are allowed to see. They only count and do not rate.
teamProgram.dashEmpty: No team in the program yet.
teamProgram.accessText: What your access to the teams in the program shows right now. The program itself opens none of this: every view is the team's own decision.
teamProgram.accessWorkstyle: The work style team report is only reachable through an active team review.
teamProgram.accessAsk: You can request a team review from the team here. You ask for Founder Setup access the usual way, through your support relationship.
teamProgram.accessNoneRight: Not shared is a valid answer and not a shortcoming.
teamProgram.accessEmpty: No team in the program yet.
teamProgram.requestHint: The team decides for itself under Account. The review only becomes active once everyone has agreed, and it ends again with any change in the team.
teamProgram.inviteMailSent: The invitation is on its way by email. We only used the address for that and did not store it.
teamProgram.inviteMailFailed: The email could not be sent. Pass the link below on yourself.
teamProgram.inviteMailInvalid: The email address does not look right. The link is still below.
teamProgram.inviteLimit: There are already 25 open invitations. Withdraw one or wait until one expires.
teamProgram.codesText: A team can join on its own with a code. Each code applies to a limited number of teams and expires; you can revoke it at any time. Everyone on the team still has to agree.
teamProgram.codeLimit: There are already five active codes. Revoke one before creating a new one.
teamProgram.codeEntryText: Did an organization give you a program code? Enter it here.
teamProgram.codeEntryInvalid: The code has eight characters made of letters and digits.
teamProgram.codeInvalid: This code is not valid (any more) – or you entered a wrong code too often. Try again in an hour.
teamProgram.codeNoTeam: You have no team that could join with this code.
teamProgram.inviteCardText: You create a link that the team redeems. Optionally we send it by email to a founder.
teamProgram.newTeamIntro: You do not have a team yet. Create one here: you join the program right away and can invite your co-founders afterwards. You can also start on your own for now.
teamProgram.newTeamHint: The program only becomes visible to the organization once at least two people are in the team and everyone has agreed.
teamProgram.newTeamNeedsFounder: To create a team you need the role “Founder” in your profile. Add it, then come back with your code.
teamProgram.waitingText: Your team is just you so far. It becomes visible to the organization once at least one more person has joined and agreed.
teamProgram.soloText: This team has only one person. If that is intended, you can mark the team as complete. It then counts as active for you. The person's agreement is still required.
teamProgram.soloTeamText: If you really are just one person, mark your team as complete. The organization then sees your program right away.
teamProgram.soloMarkedForTeam: Your team is marked as a one-person team. If a second person joins, both have to agree.
teamProgram.setupText: The agreements everyone on the team has confirmed together. Read-only. Drafts and items not every person has confirmed are missing.
teamProgram.setupNotIncluded: This program started before the Founder Setup was part of the agreement, so it is not visible here.
teamProgram.setupEmpty: There are no jointly confirmed items in the Founder Setup yet.
teamProgram.meaningWithoutSetup: Agreeing meant: the organization sees what your team enters into the program. Work styles, Founder Setup and team review stay separate approvals and are not opened by this.
teamProgram.removeTeamText: The team is told. Your access ends immediately, and the team's program data (contact people, program profile, milestones, updates, attendance entries, notes on the team) is deleted. This cannot be undone. The team can join again later with a new code or invitation.
teamProgram.teamRemoved: The team was removed from the program and informed.
teamProgram.retentionTitle: What happens to the data when a team leaves
teamProgram.retentionText: If a team is removed from the program or ends its participation, your access ends and the team's program data (contact people, program profile, milestones, updates, attendance entries, notes on the team) is deleted. We deliberately chose not to retain anything: the team only agreed within the program. If you need information for your own evaluation, record it in your own files beforehand, with the team's knowledge.
teamProgram.planText: Sketch your program: education sessions, internal and external events with date, place, notes and to-dos. The teams in your program see the plan.
teamProgram.planAttendanceNote: You enter attendance by hand (present, absent, excused). Next to it you see who said they're coming – the teams enter that themselves. Each team only sees its own entry. The entries are deleted as soon as the team leaves the program.
teamProgram.planSpeakersNone: No one in the list yet. Add people under "Experts", then choose here.
teamProgram.planSpeakersNote: Only your organization sees this. Teams see the event, but no speaker names.
teamProgram.planAttendanceEmpty: No teams with an active program.
teamProgram.planError: That did not work. Check the details (title, date) and try again.
teamProgram.myPlanText: Events of the organizations whose program you are active in. Say whether you're coming – for yourself or for the whole team at once. Attendance is entered by the contacts; you only see your team's entry.
teamProgram.notesEndNote: The notes on this team are deleted as soon as the team leaves the program or is removed.
teamProgram.outcomesTextTeam: Record what you have achieved. The organization confirms it. Only then does the star count.
teamProgram.outcomesTextOrg: The stars belong to this one team. Confirm what the team reports, or record it yourselves. There is no comparison between teams.
teamProgram.catalogText: Which results count in your program and how many stars they give (1 to 3). Teams and you record from this catalog.
teamProgram.catalogNote: Stars belong to one team each. There is no ranking and no total across teams.
teamProgram.catalogError: That did not work. The catalog holds at most 60 items.
teamProgram.outcome_pitch_held: Pitched in front of an audience
teamProgram.commentMine: What does this mean for us? (optional)
teamProgram.rewardsEditorText: Decide what happens at how many stars, for example a coaching session or an introduction. The platform awards nothing; teams see how far they are, and you redeem.
teamProgram.checkInText: Record when you talked about where the team stands and what the achievements mean. Both sides read the summary.
teamProgram.enrollOtherWay: Here you enroll teams in your program. To follow a person or a team with a report instead, use “Invite”.
teamProgram.dashBarsNote: The bars show how many teams are in each batch and category. They only count, and the order is by name.
teamProgram.dashOutcomesNote: How many teams in a batch reached each item. Only results confirmed by both sides are counted. There is no star total and no ranking; the order is that of the catalog.
teamProgram.outcomesCountedNote: Your confirmed results are included, without team names, in counts per batch that only the organization sees, for example "3 of 5 teams have a pilot customer".
teamProgram.orgDataTitle: Team master data (for your organization only)
teamProgram.orgDataText: The list you keep about your startups anyway: name, legal form, address, contact person, contact details, admission date, internal number and a note.
teamProgram.orgDataTeamSees: The team sees this in its program but cannot change it. So do not write anything the team should not read. It is deleted when the program ends.
teamProgram.orgDataTeamTitle: What your organization keeps about you
teamProgram.orgDataTeamText: Your organization enters this itself. You can read it but not change it. Talk to your contact person if something is wrong.
teamProgram.orgDataTeamEmpty: Your organization has not entered anything yet.
teamProgram.materialsText: Links to your own storage: folders, slides, recordings. The teams in the program see them on their program page.
teamProgram.materialsNote2: Made2Found stores no files, only the link. Whoever opens it lands in your storage and needs the right access there. Check that the teams may open the folder.
teamProgram.materialsError: The link could not be saved. It must start with https://, and only the owner can add it.
teamProgram.learningText: Organize your learning content into modules with lessons. Each lesson points to an address: a video, slides, a Canva presentation. Teams in the program see published modules on their program page.
teamProgram.learningNote: Made2Found stores none of this and embeds nothing, only the link is kept here. An unlisted YouTube video does not show up in search, but anyone with the link can watch and share it. We do not record who opens what.
teamProgram.learningNoLessons: No lesson in this module yet.
teamProgram.learningAudienceNote: With nothing ticked the module is a draft. People only appear here while they have released their profile to you. If they withdraw the release, the module is gone for them at once. Anyone who sees it does not see who else has access.
teamProgram.learningAudienceError: The audience could not be saved. Teams and people must belong to your organization, and people must have released their profile to you.
teamProgram.learningSpeakerNote: The name is visible to teams. Only enter it if the person agreed to it being shared.
teamProgram.learningError: That could not be saved. The address must start with https://, and only the owner can change the learning area.
teamProgram.myLearningText: Learning content that your organization or your advisor has unlocked for you. A click opens the address in a new tab, where the rules of that service apply.
teamProgram.myMaterialsText: Your organization linked these for the program.
teamProgram.expertsText: Your internal list: contact, topic and the link to the storage for offers and invoices. The teams in the program do not see it.
teamProgram.expertsPrivacy: This holds data of third parties who have no Made2Found account. As an organization you are responsible for this data yourselves: inform the people, keep your privacy policy up to date and delete entries on request. Made2Found only provides the field and does not do this for you. Enter only what you need, and no prices or invoices, only the link to your storage.
teamProgram.expertsOfferLinkHint: Only a link to your own storage. Made2Found stores no files and no amounts.
teamProgram.expertsNote: Note (for example: other offers such as 1:1 coaching)
teamProgram.expertsError: The entry could not be saved. A name is required, addresses must start with https://, and only the owner can add entries.
teamProgram.rsvpSetForYou: Entered for you – you can change it.
teamProgram.rsvpWholeLabel: For everyone who hasn't answered themselves yet:
teamProgram.rsvpNote: Your team and the program leads see your reply. Anyone who answered themselves is not overwritten.
teamProgram.planRsvpSummary: {yes} coming · {no} can't make it · {open} not answered

programPage.title: Program page
programPage.text: Your own landing page for your program: with logo, welcome text and a field for the program code. You only share this link or QR code with teams. Only what you enter here is public, and only once you tick the box.
programPage.ownerOnly: The owner of the organization sets up the program page.
programPage.publishedHint: Without the tick the page cannot be reached. With it, anyone with the link can see it. It only shows the name, logo and your text.
programPage.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only. It appears in the address and can be changed, then the old link stops working.
programPage.welcomePlaceholder: Welcome to the program! Enter your program code here and get started.
programPage.draftNote: Not published yet: this page is only a preview. Tick the box and save.
programPage.codeInvalid: The code has eight characters made of letters and digits.
programPage.step2: Sign in or create an account.
programPage.step4: Everyone on the team agrees, then you are in the program.
programPage.privacyNote: By joining, the organization sees what your team enters into the program, and the agreements confirmed together in the Founder Setup, read-only. Work styles and other approvals stay separate decisions. The organization also records whether your team took part in program events; you see your own entry. It sees your replies to events, with names.

errors.slug_taken: This short name is already taken. Choose another one.
errors.slug_invalid: The short name may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (at least 3 characters) and must not be reserved. Publishing needs a short name.
errors.logo: The logo could not be saved. Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP under 2 MB.
errors.failed: That did not work. Please try again.

programPage.formatHint: Bold: **text**, italic: *text*, list: lines starting with "- ". A+ and A− change the size in steps, one step per click (up to three larger, two smaller). Without a selection the word at the cursor is used. The three alignment buttons apply to every line under the selection (without one: the current line); by hand: ::c for centred or ::r for right at the start of a line.
programPage.accentHint: Pick a ready-made gradient or type your own hex codes like #6D49E0. Two identical colors make a solid fill. The text turns light or dark automatically so it stays readable.

myProgram.pageText: Milestones, achievements and updates with your teams, even without an organization.
myProgram.title: Take teams through a program
myProgram.text: You bring teams into your own program and support them with milestones, updates and, if you like, achievements you celebrate together. You do not need a large organization for this.
myProgram.points: Enroll teams by link, email or code. | Keep milestones, updates and dates. | Celebrate achievements as stars, switched on and off as you like. | A team only joins once everyone on the team has agreed.
myProgram.hint: This creates an organization in the background, in which you are the only member. You can invite colleagues later under “Members”.

programReport.title: Report
programReport.text: Numbers on your events, attendance and conversations – for reports to funders or for yourselves. Counts only, no rating; teams are listed alphabetically.
programReport.scopeOwner: You see every team with an active program.
programReport.scopeContact: You see the teams you are the contact for.
programReport.totalEventsNote: {planned, plural, =0 {none more planned} one {# more planned} other {# more planned}}
programReport.totalCheckInsNote: {teams, plural, =0 {with no team} one {with # team} other {with # teams}}
programReport.checkInsOff: Progress conversations are recorded when “Achievements” is switched on.
programReport.attendanceNote: Counted per team and event. An event only counts for a team from the day it joined the program.
programReport.matrixText: The entry per team and past event. A dash means the event took place before the team joined the program.
programReport.empty: In this period there are no events and no teams with an active program.
programReport.downloadNote: The files open in Excel or Numbers. The content of conversations is not included, only count and date.

funding.title: Funding requirements
funding.text: What your funding requires – entered, ticked off and ready for the funder report. Where possible the status counts itself from the program plan, attendance and check-ins; you add the rest with evidence.
funding.emptyText: Add the grant with its period, then the requirements from the award letter. Counting happens within the period.
funding.ownerOnly: Grants and requirements are set up by the people leading the organization.
funding.visibleTeamsOnly: You see per-team numbers only for teams you support. The lead pulls the complete report.

form.title: Requirement
form.notes: Note (e.g. clause in the award letter)
form.hint: One-off: fulfilled by one piece of evidence or a done task. Target number: for the whole organization. Per team: for each team in the program. Anything that does not fit the kind is counted by hand.

report.footnote: Counted from the program plan, attendance and check-ins within the period, plus the recorded evidence. Per-team numbers only for teams in the program.

snapshots.title: Keep the status
snapshots.text: When a program ends, the system deletes that team's attendance and check-ins. So a report does not shrink later, keep the status – for example before the interim report. A kept status stays as it is.
